seo.title: seoHomeTitle
seo.minimum_data: None by design, and this is the one page where that is correct rather than a waiver. The home page's block count does not depend on any entity's data depth: browse always renders (it is registry-driven), and the fixtures hero is omitted whole when it has nothing to say. #845's minimum-data gate governs the entity pages it generates thousands of, not the three locale roots.
seo.url_permanence_note: The locale root is the most permanent URL on the site. Its CONTENT changed here (#367 replaced the scaffold); the URL did not.
